Triage Agent a pipeline breaks; the agent reads it

At amber I built an agent that watches our CI/CD pipelines. When a build fails it reads the log, asks Kubernetes, git, and the cloud provider what changed, decides whether the failure is real or just flaky, and then fixes it, retries it, or asks a person first. Below is a simulation you can run. The full write-up is a case study on the builds page.
